note: development only. No bootstrap between policies at this step. The internal verification and the validation were not computed on.

diagnostic_without_stop.note: OUTSIDE THE PROTOCOL — the same rules with the peak stop never firing. Measures the cost of the stop; never a candidate.

score.selection_rule: highest annualised net return on development among the variants with max drawdown <= 50 % and median realised exposure >= 80 % in their top conviction decile; tie -> earlier variant; none -> nothing goes to verification

definitions.breadth_net: production's net directional breadth on the four tradables, confirmed regimes, in [-1, 1]
definitions.risk_off: production's confirmed global risk_off (1) or not (0), five-asset breadth
definitions.mom_30d: Σ w·log(close / close 30 days earlier), daily
definitions.mom_90d: Σ w·log(close / close 90 days earlier), daily
definitions.mom_180d: Σ w·log(close / close 180 days earlier), daily
definitions.vol_30d: annualised standard deviation of the daily basket log return over 30 days
definitions.drawdown_365d: log of the basket index over its 365-day high (≤ 0)
definitions.rsi_median_4h: production's median 4h RSI over the five regime assets
definitions.range_position_30d: Σ w·position in the 30-day range (production signal), in [0, 1]
definitions.volume_ratio_30_180: log(mean quote volume 30 d / mean quote volume 180 d), four tradables summed
definitions.taker_buy_7d: Σ taker buy quote / Σ quote volume over 7 days, four tradables, minus 0.5
